npcs.name: Sunny
npcs.wants_to_say: His brother Mordret is his obsessive rival and has tried repeatedly to claim his soul.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He knows a cult holds his True Name and will strike again when he is vulnerable.

npcs.name: Jet
npcs.wants_to_say: She leads the First Irregular Company with Sunny and five other Ascended, and respects his cunning.

npcs.name: Nephis
npcs.wants_to_say: She chooses to protect those she considers hers.

npcs.name: Weaver
npcs.wants_to_say: The Weaver wants her Spell's binding of the Forgotten God to hold and quietly keeps a watch on Sunny.
npcs.wants_to_hide: She secretly watches Sunny as an unexpected contingency she did not design.

npcs.name: Gunlaug
npcs.wants_to_say: Gunlaug demands order and obedience in Dark City and expects people to accept his laws over justice.

npcs.name: Asterion
npcs.wants_to_say: Asterion finds Sunny fascinating, as something new the Spell is making, and wants to see what he becomes.

npcs.name: Mordret
npcs.wants_to_say: Mordret wants to offer Sunny a partnership and to take his soul to cure his own dissolving identity.
npcs.wants_to_hide: His identity is dissolving and he believes Sunny's complete soul would cure it.

npcs.name: Cassie
npcs.wants_to_say: She wants to understand the Spell's true purpose: that it binds the Forgotten God and uses humanity as fuel.

npcs.name: Ki Song
npcs.wants_to_say: Ki Song wants to preserve Divine power, and treats Sunny as her student whose potential she first saw.

npcs.name: Effie
npcs.wants_to_say: She is a senior instructor at the Awakened Academy and trains Rank 1-2 Awakened.

npcs.name: Old Tom
npcs.wants_to_say: Old Tom wants the Covenant's sanctuary rules in Antarctica observed and explains them to those he shelters.
npcs.wants_to_hide: His true name is unknown; he may be a diminished Divine being or something older than the Divine-human distinction.

npcs.name: Titan
npcs.wants_to_say: Titan wants the Antarctic survivors protected and treats strength as a duty to those who cannot fight.

npcs.name: Sol
npcs.wants_to_say: He waits to return and sees the Shadow God as his mortal enemy, the being who killed him.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He is not truly dead: fragments of him persist and he waits to return.

npcs.name: Aiko
npcs.wants_to_say: Aiko wants her Clan's operations ready and wants nothing to threaten Sunny.
npcs.wants_to_hide: She is Sunny's Paired-Name partner, a bond of shadow and light deeper than love, friendship or blood.

npcs.name: elder
npcs.wants_to_say: She wants people to see the threads of fate that connect them and the Dream Weavers' study of perception.

npcs.name: Eurys
npcs.wants_to_say: He carries ancient knowledge of the Doom War and the true history of the world.

npcs.name: Whispering Blade
aliases: The Demon of Secrets and Assassination
npcs.wants_to_say: Madoc wants to recruit or destroy Sunny and is genuinely interested in him.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He took Valor soldiers into the Dream Realm and vanished while the clan pretended he was still there.
